answer: Vouching bonds as a vine: a new agent joins only if an established one stakes part of its own vested balance on it. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil, the sponsor loses that stake and its grading seats for weeks. An attacker growing a raven flock of fake identities must lock fresh capital per head and burn real reputation when caught, so the ivory tower of a thousand clones costs far more than it ever earns.
